alert_news.title: KPTCL Launches India's First OT Cyber Security Programme for Power Grid
bullets: India’s first Operational Technology (OT) cyber security programme launched by Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation (KPTCL) to protect the state’s power transmission network.
Programme covers 1,474 substations and six Area Load Dispatch Centre (ALDC) locations under an integrated secure infrastructure solution.
Includes OT firewalls, network segmentation, zero‑trust access controls, advanced threat‑prevention systems, and centralised monitoring via KPTCL’s Data Centre and Disaster Recovery facilities.

alert_news.title: India's First Fully Industry-Manufactured PSLV Set For Maiden Launch In First Quarter Of 2027
bullets: First fully industry-manufactured Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) in India, produced by a consortium of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited and Larsen & Toubro under a Rs 860 crore contract from NewSpace India Limited.
PSLV‑N1, weighing approximately 320 tonnes, is a medium‑lift expendable launcher scheduled for launch in the first quarter of 2027.
This milestone marks the transition from ISRO‑only production to private‑sector end‑to‑end manufacturing, boosting India’s launch cadence and commercial space capabilities.

alert_news.title: India’s first X‑ray Polarimeter Satellite launched by ISRO
bullets: India’s first X‑ray polarimeter satellite, XpoSat, was launched from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, by ISRO.
XpoSat will enable the scientific community to study X‑ray emissions from cosmic sources, enhancing understanding of black holes and other high‑energy phenomena.

alert_news.title: India’s First Dedicated Quantum‑AI University Campus Inaugurated
bullets: India’s first dedicated quantum‑AI university campus inaugurated at Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, by NIELIT.

Temporary campus houses 4 labs (quantum computing, quantum communication, chip design & VLSI, AI & computing) with ₹47 crore investment; permanent campus planned at Nidamarru, Amaravati with ₹730.70 crore.

alert_news.title: India's First Hypereteone Species Discovered in Bay of Bengal
bullets: First discovery of a new Hypereteone species (Hypereteone indica) in Indian waters, found at Udaypur beach (Balasore, Odisha) and Hijli beach (Purba Medinipur, West Bengal) by ZSI, Federal University of Maranhão, and West Bengal State University.
First new Hypereteone species identified in India in over 90 years; species described in 2026 after 2025 collections.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous H5N1 Avian Influenza Vaccine Developed by ICAR
bullets: India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine (targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a) developed by ICAR‑NIHSAD, Bhopal.
First vaccine worldwide for this specific H5N1 variant; aims to protect poultry and curb economic losses.

alert_news.title: India's First Laser‑Link Drone Communication System Developed Under DRDO Contract
bullets: India's first laser‑link drone communication system under a DRDO contract for olee.space, featuring free‑space optical terminals with automatic PAT.
System will provide secure, high‑speed, two‑way data link between ground stations and drones over long line‑of‑sight ranges; 18‑month development timeline.

alert_news.title: India's first bullet train to undergo trials in May 2027, Railway Minister announces
bullets: India's first bullet train project on 50‑km Surat‑Bilimora stretch of Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor
Electrification completed with 2×25 kV traction system; trial to use B‑28 train capable of 280 km/h

alert_news.title: Ashok Leyland Flags Off India's First Blast-Protected Armoured Troop Transporters for CRPF
bullets: India's first completely indigenous bullet‑ and blast‑resistant Armoured Troop Transporter (ATT) built by Ashok Leyland for CRPF and BSF
28‑seater platform, 124 units under a ₹187.24 crore contract from the Ministry of Home Affairs, equipped with 360° rotating gun turret, PTZ cameras and run‑flat tires
Designed to counter IEDs, mines and gunfire, addressing vulnerabilities highlighted by the Pulwama attack

alert_news.title: Vizhinjam to get India's first outer service port
bullets: India's first outer service port – Vizhinjam International Seaport, Kerala, modeled on UAE's Fujairah.
Developed under Mission Samudra by the Kerala Maritime Board; offers bunkering, repairs, maintenance, crew changes and spare parts to vessels on the international shipping route.
